ModMetaData.name: Echo Resonance
ModMetaData.author: William
ModMetaData.description:
Echo Resonance adds a long-term colony progression system driven by the Archotech Resonator.
FEATURES - Echo Pool: Accumulate Echo points naturally as your colony thrives (skill progression, raids repelled, research, masterwork crafting, rituals, quadrum survival). - Archotech Resonator: The single core structure of your colony that generates and anchors Echo points. Protect it at all costs! If destroyed, unspent Echo is lost. - Attunement Pylons: Expand up to 4 pylons around the Resonator to boost Echo generation speed up to x3.0. - Tiered Perk System: Unlock powerful, game-changing perks across 4 branches (Flesh, Mind, Livelihood, Combat) without hard slot caps. - Escalating Costs & Specialization Discounts: Multi-perk pawns cost exponentially more Echo, but perks matching a pawn's existing branch gain a 25% specialization discount.
